items.body_excerpt: This also led to the NCAA Tournament leaving North Carolina in 2017 as well — on an accelerated timeline. The ripple effect was Duke (with freshman Jayson Tatum starring alongside Grayson Allen) having to play South Carolina in the state of South Carolina — and getting upset in the second round.
